iconicAnchor.label: Kiss-cut sticker sheet construction
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: Cricut defines kiss-cutting as cutting the sticker layer while leaving the backing intact, the central physical signal of a sticker sheet.

sources.title: Introducing Create Sticker in Design Space
supports: A kiss cut follows each design through the sticker material while preserving a shared backing sheet.

sources.title: Custom Kiss-Cut Stickers
supports: Kiss-cut stickers retain backing and border, which support easy peeling, handling, and a visible frame around each shape.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches visible backing sheet, kiss cut outline, coordinated motif family, efficient nesting, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/sticker-sheet-system/generated-lead.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
